$comment: Plus, More reminders (migration 031; specs/plus-more-reminders.md; UX 12 Nov). The rules both clients and update_extra_reminders run. user_settings.extra_reminder_times (get_me's settings) holds up to maxExtra whole-minute times, sorted, each at least minGapMinutes from reminder_time and from each other, measured around midnight. errors: update_extra_reminders' exception messages, in the order it checks them. Adding needs Plus (has_plus, 028); a list that is a subset of the stored one never does. A new reminder_time drops the extras within minGapMinutes of it: compare the list before and after update_settings and show removedLine once per removed time. Ids: the phone's notification block for the extras.
removedLineEn: Removed your {time} reminder: it was within an hour of your new time.
